description: This file defines the LogicExpression interface, which models internal representations of LogicCriteria in the OpenMRS logic module. It specifies methods for accessing operators, operands, root tokens, and transformations associated with logical expressions used in the backend engine of the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: LogicExpression
classes.description: An interface representing internal logic expressions used within the OpenMRS logic criteria system, supporting binary and unary expressions, with methods to access operators, operands, root tokens, and transformations.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator associated with this LogicExpression.

methods.name: getRootToken
methods.description: Returns the root token of this LogicExpression, representing its primary identifier.

methods.name: getRightOperand
methods.description: Returns the right operand of this LogicExpression, applicable for binary and unary expressions.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Retrieves the transformation expression applied to this LogicExpression.

methods.name: setTransform
methods.description: Sets the transformation expression for this LogicExpression.
